sloka: वदतो वै वसिष्ठस्य मा भै इति मुहुर्मुहुः ।नाशयामि अद्य गाधेयम् नीहारम् इव भास्करः ॥१-५५-२५॥
transliteration: vadato vai vasiṣṭhasya mā bhai iti muhurmuhuḥ ।nāśayāmi adya gādheyam nīhāram iva bhāskaraḥ ॥1-55-25॥

translations.english: Even while Vasistha was repeatedly assuring the saints saying "Do not fear, I will now destroy Viswamitra, son of Gadhi just as the Sun dispels the morning mist (they fled)".
